card.name: Points just before a precaution or required action
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in warning text that come right before a precaution or required step, such as 'Pre' in 'Warnings and Precautions', a comma after 'therefore', or a closing parenthesis after an abbreviation before 'infection before initiating treatment'.

modes.label: Warnings and Precautions cross-reference
modes.description: The start of 'Precautions' in a bracketed section reference.
modes.example: for a personal or family history of bipolar disorder, mania, or hypomania prior to initiating treatment with EXXUA [see Warnings and<< Pre>>cautions (5.3) ]

modes.label: Comma after 'therefore'
modes.description: The comma that leads into a recommended examination or monitoring step.
modes.example: Therefore<<,>> careful monitoring of blood glucose is recommended when

modes.label: Closing bracket after virus abbreviation
modes.description: The parenthesis ending 'hepatitis B virus (HBV)' just before a testing instruction.
modes.example: Test all patients for evidence of current or prior hepatitis B virus (HBV<<)>> infection before initiating treatment with SOVALDI
